S28.01.needs: a chat that makes an HTML or React artifact
S28.01.note: The Code view is a read-only pre/code block (artifactPanel.ts sets textContent); no edit control or contenteditable was found, so editing is likely not possible.
steps: Ask the chat for a small HTML page or a React component so it creates an artifact card.
Click the artifact card to open the artifact panel.
Click Code.
Try to type or change text in the code box, then close and reopen the panel and check whether the change was kept, and compare with Expected.
S28.01.where: Side panel chat > answer with an artifact card > click the card > Code

S28.02.note: Each artifact is a single file shown in one panel; no file tree was found. Searched apps/extension/src for tree, file tree and project in the side panel and artifact code.

S28.09.needs: a chat that makes an HTML or React artifact
S28.09.note: The artifact panel has Preview and Code buttons that switch one view at a time (artifactPanel.ts selectView); no side-by-side split view was found.

S28.10.needs: a chat that makes an HTML artifact
S28.10.note: If the live preview cannot start, the panel shows the source with the text "The live preview is not available right now, so the panel shows the source."
steps: Ask the chat for a single HTML page with a button, for example a small counter.
Click the artifact card to open the artifact panel.
Check that the Preview button is pressed and the page appears.
Click the page's button and check that the page responds live, and compare with Expected.
S28.10.where: Side panel chat > answer with an HTML artifact card > click the card > Preview

S28.11.needs: a chat that makes a React artifact
steps: Ask the chat for a small React component, for example a button that changes a number.
Click the artifact card to open the artifact panel.
Check that the Preview button is pressed and the component renders.
Click the component's button and check that it responds, and compare with Expected.
S28.11.where: Side panel chat > answer with a React artifact card > click the card > Preview

S28.16.needs: a chat that makes an artifact that fails to render
S28.16.note: The error shows as a text line in the panel, not an overlay, and there is no retry button; switching to Code is the only recovery found.
steps: Open an HTML or React artifact that fails when it runs (an artifact whose code throws an error on load).
Click the artifact card and look under the Preview and Code buttons for the message "The preview could not start. Review the source or try again."
Click Code to review the source and recover.
Compare with Expected: an overlay with a way to recover.
S28.16.where: Side panel chat > answer with an HTML or React artifact card > click the card > Preview

S28.18.needs: a chat that makes an HTML or React artifact
S28.18.note: There is no Reload button; switching Code then Preview creates a new preview frame (artifactPanel.ts mountFrame). Whether state resets is inferred from the code, not verified.
steps: Open a previewable artifact in the artifact panel with Preview showing.
Click Code.
Click Preview.
Check that the page is rebuilt from its start, and compare with Expected.
S28.18.where: Side panel chat > answer with an HTML or React artifact card > click the card > Code, then Preview

S28.19.note: No restart control for the preview runtime was found. Searched apps/extension/src for restart, reload and runtime controls; only the message about AI and saved data for published apps was found.

S28.24.needs: a chat that makes an artifact
S28.24.note: The download icon has a tooltip and label but no visible text; it saves one artifact file, not a whole project.
steps: Ask the chat for a small HTML page or a React component so it creates an artifact card.
Hover the download icon on the card and read its tooltip.
Click the download icon and check for the status text "Saved" followed by the file name.
Open the saved file and compare its code with Expected.
S28.24.where: Side panel chat > answer with an artifact card > Download icon labelled "Download $FILE$" (also in the panel header after clicking the card)

S28.25.note: Only single-file download of one artifact was found (artifactDownload in artifactPanel.ts). Searched apps/extension/src for zip, archive and export.

S28.27.note: No publish-to-preview control was found. The only web action is "Run $TITLE$ in this chat on the web", which opens the chat in the browser, not a shareable preview link.

S28.28.note: No in-app production publish control was found. Searched apps/extension for publish; the only match is the Chrome Web Store release script, which is not an app control.

S28.30.note: No rollback or version-restore control for artifacts was found. Searched apps/extension/src for rollback, roll back, restore and version in artifact code.
